# Fixture standards

Use Python's standard library. Keep the three public function interfaces stable. Test observable values through public functions with unittest and literal expectations. Preserve baseline assertions. Avoid dependencies and unrelated code.

Run Python with `-B` so behavior checks do not create bytecode artifacts.
files.README.md:
# Python standard-library smoke fixture

Legacy baseline: `normalize_name("Ada") == "Ada"`, `parse_limit("1") == 1`. Whitespace normalization, general integer parsing and message rendering are intentionally incomplete.

Baseline: `python3 -B -m unittest tests.test_baseline -v`
Full suite: `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
Initialization: None. Typecheck: N/A; this unannotated standard-library fixture has no static typechecker or typecheck configuration. Runtime behavior is checked by unittest.

Approved slices: 01 edits normalize.py/tests/test_normalize.py, 02 edits limits.py/tests/test_limits.py, 03 edits message.py/tests/test_message.py and depends on 01/02. Fault-only tracked edits to normalize.py plus untracked fault-note.txt are declared within ticket 01's Files for that run. No push, PR or deployment.

Use local Markdown under `.scratch/<slug>/`: spec.md, issues/NN-title.md, Status lines and append-only Comments. The planner owns these run files.
